name: Pixel Wall
hook: One shared canvas, one pixel at a time.
how: Place one pixel every couple of seconds. Work with others to draw something, or paint over them. Bots paint little pictures while you wait for company.
controls: Click or tap a square to paint, drag to move, scroll or pinch to zoom
uses: The wall is remembered by the players who painted it: whoever comes back first brings it back for everyone.
Change the wait between pixels, the palette or the theme banner with no new deploy.
The players who have placed the most pixels.
The host's browser checks every pixel and the wait between them; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots paint hearts, trees and space invaders (and wipe and redo their old ones once the wall is full) until enough people join.
ideas: Make the canvas bigger, with zoom
